name: Bánhorváti (Hungary)
description: A vertical white banner charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Bánhorváti: a yellow and blue shield with a black bird crest and crossed hammers, within a green wreath, above a scroll.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Bánhorváti arms with crest, wreath and scroll
